why_choose_us.title: You call the owners, not a call center
why_choose_us.description: Alex answers (570) 880-1640 and Luis answers (570) 453-8725. The people who quote your job are the people who show up to do it, and they are the people you reach if something needs attention afterward.

why_choose_us.title: We are actually from here
why_choose_us.description: Our shop is at 77 Center St in Pittston — you can look it up, drive past it, and find us again next spring. After a big storm, a lot of the crews knocking on doors in Luzerne and Lackawanna County are from out of state. We are not.

why_choose_us.title: No job is too small
why_choose_us.description: A dozen missing shingles, one leaking valley, a section of gutter pulling away from the fascia. Plenty of larger outfits will not quote work that small. We will, and we price it the same way we price a full replacement.

why_choose_us.title: 100% guaranteed best prices
why_choose_us.description: We stand behind our commitment to the most competitive pricing in Northeast Pennsylvania, including a price match on comparable services. Every estimate is free and yours to take to another contractor if you want to.
